issue: The six Mayhem validators read the captured Mayhem image, the captured dependency ELFs and the program sources they hash into the receipt, then truncated --output with write_text. Passing an input as --output destroyed the evidence, or replaced the executing script with its own report.
affected: scripts/mayhem_validate_{admin,fee_recipient,quote_withdraw,sweeps,extend,withdraw}.py at base; each writer is the last statement of the module-level main block
finding: Base run of the new test: 24 failing subtests in 5 tests. --output evidence/original/mayhem/deployed.so truncated the captured image; --output scripts/mayhem_validate_admin.py replaced the module with the receipt, so the same run's later import raised NameError: name 'null' is not defined. The sibling Pump runners already admit their report through scripts/pump_differential_output.py: PumpReport.
